title: brodiaea pulchella var. pauciflora
intro:

The few-flowered brodiaea has been studied for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation.

The bioactive constituents of Brodiaea pulchella var. pauciflora have been identified as alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, although a more in-depth analysis of its chemical composition is required to confirm its full potential.
